Container.Name: openrcs
Container.Overview: Google Messages (SMS/RCS) for AI agents over MCP, reachable only on your tailnet. Leave "Use Tailscale" on with Tailscale Serve on port 3000: the app listens on loopback inside the container and publishes no ports. On first start, open the container log and follow the Tailscale login link. Setup guide: docs/self-hosting.md in the project.
Container.Requires: A Tailscale account with MagicDNS and HTTPS certificates enabled.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app and its data files run as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app and its data files run as.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, generated secrets and Tailscale state. Back up this folder as a whole.

Config.Name: OPENRCS_URL
Config.Description: Leave empty with 'Use Tailscale' on: the container detects its https://name.tailnet.ts.net address. Set it only if Tailscale runs outside this container.

Config.Name: KEY_PEPPER
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one into the data folder on first start. base64 of 32 bytes.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one into the data folder on first start.
